state.paragraph: unintended public disclosure. Accordingly, the Company set the evening of Wednesday, December 10 (five days, rather than 10 days prior to the anticipated December 15 completion date) as the deadline for submission of final bids, and at the same time asked the bidders to submit mark-ups of the draft merger agreement and the other transaction documents and financing commitments, if possible, in advance.

ledger_rows.Note: Preliminary non-binding IOI; range. Consortium led by BC Partners funds (later with CDPQ, GIC, StepStone). Terms beyond price not reported.
Preliminary non-binding IOI; range. Advanced 11/03; on recommended reading, later part of Bidder 3.
Third of three IOIs whose range “reached at least $80.00”; endpoints not disclosed, so price cells blank. Advanced 11/03; on recommended reading, later part of Bidder 3.
Preliminary non-binding IOI at a point price.
Six IOIs in total; the remaining two, prices undisclosed but below the $80.00 cut-off (inferred from the board’s advancement rule). Reasons section says IOIs came from 5 bidder groups.
15 signers − 6 submitters = 9. J.P. Morgan heard their rationales for not submitting (10/30–11/02); rationales not disclosed. Would be 10 if only 5 IOIs (Q4).
Revises #19 after J.P. Morgan calls on rationales for price levels; raised $78.00 to a range, bringing it above the $80.00 cut-off.

Board advanced four bidders at or above $80.00 (Buyer Group, Bidder 2, Unnamed financial bidders 1 and 2) to the “final round”; November diligence, management presentations, updated FY2014 projections for all.
Below board’s $80.00 cut-off; notified after the meeting. None indicated interest or ability to go above its initial indication.
Final bids initially due Friday 12/05/2014, with completion targeted 12/15. In November form merger agreement circulated with instruction to submit comments together with final bids.

Ad hoc committee let two bidders work together: one (final-round invitee) wanted an equity partner given deal size; other would drop out otherwise. Members inferred as bidders 1 and 2. Count = net reduction.
Final-bid due date moved from 12/05 to evening of 12/10 to shorten post-bid period and leak risk; bidders asked to send markups and financing commitments in advance.

Final bid letter with revised merger agreement and transaction documents. Financing commitment documents supplied 12/06. Documents less conditional than Bidder 2’s. Not dependent on Longview rollover.

Final bid letter with revised merger agreement and transaction documents; documents more conditional than Buyer Group’s; financing status not reported until 12/12. Would partner with Longview only after signing.
Final-bid due date (evening). Two written bids received; Bidder 3 gave only a verbal valuation.
Verbal valuation not above the ~$78 stock price; J.P. Morgan said it was unlikely to be competitive, so no written offer. Both sides contributed. Not mentioned again.
Neither bid acceptable unless improved: J.P. Morgan told both bidders to raise their bids, improved bids due 12/12. Treated as an extension within the final round, not a new round.

deadline.instructions: `paragraph` reports that the target or its banker sets, changes or communicates a bid deadline, process letter or request for final offers. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
